reason: Pricing examples show proactive evaluations from rules with both modes at $0 and proactive-only evaluations at $0.001, the same rate as detective evaluations.

Note states Config has its own data store and retention policies and S3 and SNS have their own separate ones.
Quota row gives 1000 per Region per account, Can be increased No; note says conformance pack rules count toward it.
Quota row gives 300 saved queries per account and Region, Can be increased Yes.

SRA page states the Config delegated admin is the Security Tooling account and snapshots go to a centralized S3 bucket in Log Archive.
Quote defines the behavior graph and the administrator role; context covers inviting members and enabling organization accounts.

Document history row dated November 26, 2023 states the feature and its IAM scope.

User guide covers management account designation and member enablement; FAQ covers same-region aggregation.
The no-additional-configuration quote is about the Security Hub CSPM integration only; the claim applies it to the GuardDuty integration as well, which no quote states.
Pricing overview states per GB per account/Region/month, no charge for enabling sources or storage, and up to a year of aggregated data.
Quote gives multiply by 30; context gives the daily average over days since enable, capped at 30.
